<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Givista – Quà Tặng Doanh Nghiệp | Hộp Quà Tết In Logo</title>
<div id="gv-root">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Be+Vietnam+Pro:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Playfair+Display:wght@600;700&family=Merriweather:wght@700;900&display=swap">
<style>
:root{--bg:#f7f8fc;--surface:#fff;--ink:#12183a;--muted:#5d6385;--brand:#001b72;--brand-ink:#fff;--gold:#b98a3e;--line:#dfe2f0;--soft:#eceffa;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0b0f24;--surface:#141a3a;--ink:#eef0fb;--muted:#a9b0d6;--brand:#6f89ff;--brand-ink:#08102e;--gold:#d3a85a;--line:#263060;--soft:#1a2147;color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0b0f24;--surface:#141a3a;--ink:#eef0fb;--muted:#a9b0d6;--brand:#6f89ff;--brand-ink:#08102e;--gold:#d3a85a;--line:#263060;--soft:#1a2147;color-scheme:dark}
html{scroll-padding-top:calc(70px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));scroll-behavior:smooth}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.6}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--surface);z-index:60}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
h1,h2,h3{margin:0;line-height:1.25}
h1,h2{font-family:"Playfair Display",Georgia,serif}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
section{padding:44px 0}
.eyebrow{color:var(--gold);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
.sh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:16px;margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sh h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3.4vw,36px)}
.more{color:var(--brand);font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--brand);color:var(--brand-ink);padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;border:0;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-weight:600}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--ink)}
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:50;background:var(--surface);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:68px;gap:16px}
.logo img{height:42px;width:auto}
nav{display:flex;gap:22px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em}
nav a:hover{color:var(--brand)}
.hot{background:var(--brand);color:var(--brand-ink);padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:900px){nav{display:none}}
.hero{padding:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--soft),var(--bg))}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.1fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;padding-top:48px;padding-bottom:48px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,52px);margin-bottom:16px}
.hero h1 em{color:var(--brand);font-style:normal}
.hero p{color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;max-width:520px;margin:0 0 26px}
.cta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.himg{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,27,114,.2);background:var(--soft);min-height:200px}
.himg img{width:100%;height:auto}
@media(max-width:800px){.hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.strip{background:var(--brand);color:var(--brand-ink);padding:14px 0;font-size:13px;font-weight:500}
.strip .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 28px;justify-content:center}
.std{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px}
.std div{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:22px}
.std b{font-family:"Playfair Display",serif;font-size:32px;color:var(--brand);display:block}
.std h3{font-size:16px;margin:4px 0}.std p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.promo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.promo div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:18px}
.promo img{width:130px;border-radius:10px;flex:none}
.promo small{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}.promo h3{font-size:20px;margin:2px 0 6px}.promo p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.grid4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.thumb{aspect-ratio:1;background:var(--soft)}
.thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .4s}
.card:hover .thumb img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.card .in{padding:12px 14px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;flex:1}
.card small{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600;font-size:12px}
.card h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35}
.kp{color:var(--brand);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;margin-top:6px}
.kp:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.price{font-weight:700;color:var(--brand);margin-top:auto}
.card button{margin-top:8px;border:1px solid var(--brand);background:transparent;color:var(--brand);border-radius:999px;padding:9px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}
.card button:hover{background:var(--brand);color:var(--brand-ink)}
.bst{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px}
.bst a{position:relative;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--soft);aspect-ratio:1}
.bst img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.bst h3{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:34px 14px 14px;color:#fff;font-size:15px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,10,50,.85))}
.cats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:34px}
.cats a{padding:9px 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);border-radius:999px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.cats a:hover{border-color:var(--brand);color:var(--brand)}
.ban{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:16px}
.bn{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;color:#f3e2b3;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.bn.g{background:#0c3b2e}.bn.b{background:#0a0a9a}
.bn .pic{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.bn .pic img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover}
.bn .tx{padding:22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;flex:1}
.bn h3{font-family:"Playfair Display",serif;font-size:26px;color:#f1d28f}
.bn p{margin:0;font-size:14px;opacity:.92}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.chips span{border:1px solid rgba(243,226,179,.6);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 14px;font-size:13px}
.bn .btn{background:#f1d28f;color:#0a0a50;align-self:flex-start;margin-top:auto}
@media(max-width:900px){.ban{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.topbar{background:#001b72;color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:500}
.topbar .wrap{display:flex;gap:26px;justify-content:flex-end;padding-top:12px;padding-bottom:12px}
.hrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding-top:14px;padding-bottom:12px}
.logo img{height:46px;width:auto}
.catwrap{position:relative}
.catbtn{background:#c41a00;color:#fff;border:0;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-weight:700;padding:14px 20px;border-radius:6px;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap}
.catmenu{display:none;position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;margin:6px 0 0;padding:6px 0;list-style:none;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);min-width:290px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);border:1px solid var(--line);z-index:70}
.catmenu.open{display:block}
.catmenu a{display:block;padding:13px 22px;font-weight:600;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.catmenu li:last-child a{border:0}
.catmenu a:hover{color:#c41a00;background:var(--soft)}
.search{flex:1;min-width:140px}
.search input{border-radius:999px;padding:13px 20px}
.ph{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.3;white-space:nowrap}
.ph span{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}.ph a{font-weight:700;font-size:18px;color:var(--brand)}
.subnav{display:flex;gap:6px 22px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:8px;padding-bottom:8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.subnav a:hover{color:#c41a00}
.subnav .tetbtn{margin-left:auto;background:#c41a00;color:#fff;padding:9px 18px;border-radius:6px}
.subnav .tetbtn:hover{color:#fff;opacity:.9}
.crumb{background:#e1ece9;text-align:center;padding:36px 20px 44px;margin-bottom:30px}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .crumb{background:var(--soft)}
.crumb small{color:var(--muted);font-size:16px}.crumb small b{color:var(--ink)}
.crumb h1{font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",sans-serif;font-weight:700;color:var(--brand);font-size:clamp(34px,6vw,64px);margin-top:10px}
.pg{padding:0 0 60px}
.hotb{position:absolute;left:10px;top:10px;background:#c41a00;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:999px}
.thumb{position:relative}
.empty{background:var(--surface);border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:40px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}
.empty a{color:var(--brand);font-weight:600}
@media(max-width:900px){.ph,.topbar{display:none}.hrow{flex-wrap:wrap}.search{order:3;flex-basis:100%}.subnav{font-size:12px}.subnav .tetbtn{margin-left:0}}
.bnr{background:#7a0c10;color:#f6e4c1;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.stack{display:grid;max-width:1500px;margin:0 auto;position:relative}
.sl{grid-area:1/1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:44px 70px 40px;min-height:640px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .6s}
.sl.on{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.red{background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 60%,#b3121b,#6d0a0e 70%)}
.navy{background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 60%,#1a2fa0,#000c3a 75%)}
.sl h1{font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:clamp(28px,4.6vw,58px);color:#f6e4c1}
.tg{letter-spacing:.3em;font-size:clamp(11px,1.3vw,15px);margin:10px 0 16px;opacity:.9}
.bbtn{background:#f1d28f;color:#4a0a0a;padding:11px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;z-index:2}
.art{position:absolute;right:90px;bottom:34px;width:min(54%,760px);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;gap:10px}
.trio img{width:32%;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.trio img:nth-child(2){width:38%;margin-bottom:26px}
.one img{width:100%;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.badges{grid-area:1/1;align-self:end;justify-self:start;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,250px));gap:18px 16px;padding:0 0 36px 90px;z-index:3;pointer-events:none}
.bd{position:relative;background:#f6e4c1;color:#4a1a10;border-radius:22px;padding:18px 16px 14px 56px;min-height:112px;display:flex;align-items:center;text-align:center;border:3px solid #fff3d6;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.bd i{position:absolute;left:-14px;top:-14px;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:#5a1210;color:#f6e4c1;display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;font-size:24px;border:3px solid #f6e4c1}
.bd span{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.04em;line-height:1.35;flex:1;font-weight:500}
.bd b{display:block;font-size:26px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:.01em}
.ar{position:absolute;top:50%;z-index:4;width:46px;height:56px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#222;font-size:34px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.ar.l{left:22px}.ar.r{right:22px}
.mq{background:#001b72;color:#f6e4c1;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;padding:18px 0}
.mqt{display:inline-block;animation:mq 40s linear infinite}
.mqt span{display:inline-block;margin:0 24px;letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:500;font-size:15px}
.mqt span::after{content:"•";margin-left:48px;opacity:.6}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.mqt{animation:none}.sl{transition:none}}
.fl{position:fixed;left:14px;bottom:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));display:grid;gap:10px;z-index:45}
.fl a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#c41a00;color:#fff;border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 8px 8px 20px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.3;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.fl b{font-size:14px}.fl i{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;font-size:18px}
@media(max-width:900px){.sl{padding:32px 20px 20px;min-height:0;justify-content:flex-start}.art{position:static;width:100%;margin-top:22px}.stack{grid-template-rows:auto auto}.badges{grid-area:2/1;justify-self:stretch;padding:26px 20px 30px;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:22px 14px;background:inherit}.bd{padding:16px 10px 12px 40px;min-height:96px}.bd b{font-size:19px}.ar{top:240px;width:36px;height:44px;font-size:26px}.ar.l{left:6px}.ar.r{right:6px}.fl a span{display:none}.fl a{padding:6px}}
.sol{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
.sc{position:relative;display:block;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/5;background:var(--t,#444)}
.sc img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .6s}
.sc:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.sc::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(transparent 45%,var(--t) 130%);opacity:.95}
.sct{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:2;padding:24px;color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.sct b{font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,24px);letter-spacing:.02em}
.sct em{font-style:normal;opacity:.95;font-size:15px;font-weight:400}
.sct u{text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;margin-top:6px}
@media(max-width:900px){.sol{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:560px){.sol{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.left{align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;justify-content:center;padding-left:90px}
.ltx{max-width:min(47%,620px);position:relative;z-index:2}
.k{letter-spacing:.14em;font-weight:700;color:#f1d28f;font-size:clamp(16px,1.9vw,26px)}
.script{font-family:"Playfair Display",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(48px,7vw,96px);color:#f1d28f;line-height:1.05;margin:6px 0 14px}
.left h1{letter-spacing:0;font-size:clamp(20px,2.3vw,32px);line-height:1.3}
.ds{margin:14px 0 4px;font-size:clamp(14px,1.3vw,17px);line-height:1.6;opacity:.95}
.pill{display:inline-block;border:1px solid #f1d28f;color:#f1d28f;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 22px;font-weight:600;margin:14px 0;font-size:14px}
.btns{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.bbtn.ghost{background:transparent;color:#f1d28f;border:1px solid #f1d28f}
.left .art.one{width:min(52%,720px);right:60px;bottom:0}
.left .art.one img{box-shadow:none;border-radius:0;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 15%);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 15%)}
@media(max-width:900px){.left{padding:32px 20px 0}.ltx{max-width:none}.left .art.one{width:100%}}
body::before{background:#001b72}
header{background:#001b72;color:#fff;border-bottom:0}
.hrow{padding-top:12px;padding-bottom:12px;gap:28px}
.logo img{height:44px}
.mnav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;flex:1;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.03em}
.mnav>a:hover,.ddb:hover{opacity:.8}
.ddb{background:none;border:0;color:inherit;font:inherit;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.03em;cursor:pointer;padding:0;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.ddb i{font-style:normal;font-size:12px}
.dd2{position:relative}
.dd2:hover .catmenu,.catwrap:hover .catmenu{display:block}
header .catmenu{top:100%;margin-top:0;padding-top:10px;background:transparent;border:0;box-shadow:none}
header .catmenu li:first-child{border-radius:8px 8px 0 0}
header .catmenu li{background:var(--surface)}
header .catmenu li:last-child{border-radius:0 0 8px 8px}
header .catmenu{filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25))}
.ico{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;margin-left:auto}
.ico a,.ico button{background:none;border:0;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;padding:0;display:flex;position:relative}
.ico a:hover,.ico button:hover{opacity:.8}
.cart b{position:absolute;right:-10px;top:-8px;background:#fff;color:#001b72;border-radius:50%;width:18px;height:18px;font-size:11px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.burger{display:none!important;font-size:26px}
.spanel{background:#001b72;padding:0 0 14px}
.spanel[hidden]{display:none}
.spanel input{border-radius:999px;padding:12px 20px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.burger{display:flex!important}.hrow{gap:16px;flex-wrap:nowrap}.mnav{display:none;position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:#001b72;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:0;padding:8px 20px 16px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2)}.mnav.show{display:flex}.mnav>a,.mnav .ddb{padding:12px 0;width:100%}.mnav .dd2,.mnav .catwrap{width:100%}header .catmenu{position:static;filter:none;padding:0}.dd2:hover .catmenu,.catwrap:hover .catmenu{display:none}.catmenu.open{display:block!important}.ico{gap:16px}}
.sl.tt{background:#040b26 url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center/cover no-repeat;min-height:clamp(420px,47.7vw,716px);padding:0;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center}
.sl.tt .bbtn{margin-bottom:16px}
@media(max-width:900px){.sl.tt{background-size:contain;background-position:center top;min-height:56vw}}
.hrow{max-width:1400px!important}
.logo img{height:52px;width:auto}
.mnav{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.04em;gap:26px;white-space:nowrap}
.ddb{font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap}
.sl h1,.left h1{font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.06em}
.left h1{font-size:clamp(20px,2.1vw,30px);line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:.03em}
.k{font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.2em}
.ds{font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(15px,1.25vw,18px)}
.pill{font-weight:500}
.ltx{max-width:min(58%,780px)}
.left .art.one{width:min(44%,620px)}
.sh h2{font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",sans-serif;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--brand)}
.sct b{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.03em}
@media(max-width:900px){.ltx{max-width:none}.left .art.one{width:100%}}
.wsec{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6e1017,#52090f 55%,#4a080d);color:#fff;display:grid;grid-template-columns:36% 1fr;padding:0;overflow:hidden;min-height:520px}
.wimg{position:relative}
.wimg img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:35% center;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 55%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 55%,transparent)}
.wbody{padding:64px 40px 56px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;max-width:1000px}
.wsec h2{font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(24px,2.9vw,40px);letter-spacing:.03em;text-align:center;margin-bottom:56px;color:#fff;text-transform:none}
.wcols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:26px;text-align:center}
.wc svg{margin:0 auto 22px;display:block}
.wc h3{font-size:clamp(16px,1.5vw,21px);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px}
.wc p{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.65;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);font-weight:300}
@media(max-width:900px){.wsec{grid-template-columns:1fr}.wimg{height:300px}.wimg img{-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 60%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 60%,transparent)}.wbody{padding:8px 20px 44px}.wsec h2{margin-bottom:34px}.wcols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:32px 18px}}
.ltx{max-width:min(42%,600px)}
.left .script{font-size:clamp(40px,5.4vw,82px)}
.left h1{font-size:clamp(18px,1.8vw,26px)}

/* ===== CTA cuối trang: to và nổi bật ===== */
.lead{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:104px 0;border-top:6px solid #f1d28f;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 12% 18%,#16349a 0%,#001b72 46%,#000a33 100%)}

#process{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;padding:56px 0}
#process .sh h2{color:#f6e4c1}
#process .eyebrow{color:#f1d28f}
.steps::before{border-color:rgba(241,210,143,.6)}
.step b{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:#f1d28f;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px var(--blue)}
.step h3{color:#f1d28f}
.step p{color:#cfd4ee}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .step h3{color:#f1d28f}
footer{background:#000c3a;color:#cfd4ee;border-top:6px solid #f1d28f}
.tbox{background:#fff}
/* ===== Nhãn lớn hơn, khoảng cách các mục gần hơn ===== */
.eyebrow{font-size:clamp(15px,1.5vw,18px);letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px}
section{padding:28px 0}
.intro{padding:30px 0}
.trust{padding:28px 0 32px}
#process{padding:38px 0}
#faq{padding:24px 0}
.lead{padding:44px 0}
.sh{margin-bottom:14px}
.trust .sh{margin-bottom:16px}
.tstats{margin-top:16px}
@media(max-width:900px){.intro{padding:26px 0}.lead{padding:36px 0}}
/* ===== Mục giới thiệu gọn, thoáng ===== */
.intro .wrap{display:block}
.ihead{text-align:center;max-width:720px;margin:0 auto 22px}
.intro h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,38px);margin:4px 0 10px}
.intro .lede{font-size:clamp(15px,1.3vw,18px);line-height:1.6;margin:0}
.igrid{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px}
.igrid li{background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:3px solid #d9bd83;border-radius:14px;padding:20px 16px;text-align:center}
.igrid i{display:grid;place-items:center;width:52px;height:52px;margin:0 auto 12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brand)}
.igrid svg{width:26px;height:26px;fill:#f1d28f}
.igrid b{display:block;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:4px}
.igrid span{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted)}
.ifoot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-top:20px}
.ifoot span{padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);margin:0}
.ifoot .early{background:#fbf1d8;border-color:#e6c981;color:#6b4a0f}
@media(max-width:900px){.igrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:520px){.igrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
/* ===== Nền ảnh: đỏ lụa, xanh hoa văn ===== */
.lead{background:linear-gradient(rgba(110,0,0,.18),rgba(50,0,0,.38)),url(data:image/webp;base64,) center/cover no-repeat #b3121b;border-top-color:#f1d28f}
.wsec{background:linear-gradient(rgba(110,0,0,.15),rgba(50,0,0,.3)),url(data:image/webp;base64,) center/cover no-repeat #a3121a}
#process{background:url(data:image/webp;base64,) center top/900px auto repeat #081a35}
.step b{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #081a35}
footer{background:url(data:image/webp;base64,) center top/900px auto repeat #081a35;color:#cfd4ee;border-top:6px solid #f1d28f}
.topbar,.mq,.strip,.bn.b{background:#081a35}
/* ===== Nền ảnh phủ toàn trang ===== */
header,body::before,.topbar,.mq,.strip,.bn.b{background:url(data:image/webp;base64,) center top/900px auto repeat #081a35}
header{color:#fff}
.bn.g{background:linear-gradient(rgba(110,0,0,.15),rgba(50,0,0,.3)),url(data:image/webp;base64,) center/cover no-repeat #a3121a}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:light){body{background:url(data:image/webp;base64,) center top/900px auto repeat #f8f1e4}
.hero,.intro,.trust,#solutions,.svs,#tet,#bst,#gv-root section[style]{background:transparent}
.soft,.crumb{background:url(data:image/webp;base64,) center top/900px auto repeat #f1e5cd}
}

function detail(id){var p=PR[id],d=DT[id]||{},L=function(a){return a&&a.length?'<ul class="pd-l">'+a.map(function(x){return '<li>'+esc(x)+'</li>'}).join('')+'</ul>':''};
 $('pm').innerHTML='<div class="pi">'+img(p)+'<h3>'+esc(p.n)+'</h3><div class="price">'+esc(p.pr)+'</div>'
 +(d.sub?'<p class="pd-sub">'+esc(d.sub)+'</p>':'')
 +(d.mo?'<p class="pd-p">'+esc(d.mo)+'</p>':'')
 +(d.tp?'<h4 class="pd-h">Thành phần trong hộp</h4>'+L(d.tp):'')

 +'<h4 class="pd-h">Dịch vụ đi kèm</h4>'+L(['In logo doanh nghiệp miễn phí, hỗ trợ thiết kế','Báo giá trọn gói, xuất hóa đơn VAT, ký hợp đồng','Giao đa điểm toàn quốc theo danh sách người nhận','Bảo hành đổi trả 1-1 theo chính sách Givista'])
 +(d.ruou?'<p class="pd-w">Sản phẩm có chứa rượu: không dành cho người dưới 18 tuổi, phụ nữ mang thai và người lái xe. Có thể đổi sang phiên bản không rượu, liên hệ để được tư vấn.</p>':'')
 +'<p class="pd-w">Giá hiển thị là giá tham khảo, có thể thay đổi theo số lượng, phương án in logo và thời điểm đặt. Hình ảnh chỉ mang tính minh họa.</p>'
 +'<div class="acts" style="display:flex;gap:8px"><button class="btn add" type="button" data-add="'+id+'" data-open style="border:0;cursor:pointer">Thêm vào giỏ</button><button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-close style="cursor:pointer">Đóng</button></div></div>';$('pm').classList.add('on');$('ov').classList.add('on')}
function theme(){var d=document.documentElement,c=d.dataset.theme||(matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme:dark)').matches?'dark':'light');return c}
function setT(t){document.documentElement.dataset.theme=t;try{localStorage.setItem('gvt',t)}catch(e){}$('tl').textContent=t==='dark'?'Sáng':'Tối'}
try{var st=localStorage.getItem('gvt');if(st)document.documentElement.dataset.theme=st}catch(e){}
$('tl').textContent=theme()==='dark'?'Sáng':'Tối';
btn.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();menu.classList.toggle('open')});
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){var t=e.target;
 if(!t.closest('.catwrap'))menu.classList.remove('open');
 var c=t.closest('[data-cat]');if(c){e.preventDefault();panel(false);var d=CATS.filter(function(x){return x.k===c.dataset.cat})[0];show(d.title||d.t,d.a,d.i);return}
 var m;
 if((m=t.closest('[data-add]'))){add(m.dataset.add,1);if(m.hasAttribute('data-open'))panel(true);else{m.textContent='Đã thêm ✓';setTimeout(function(){m.textContent='Thêm vào giỏ'},900)}return}
 if((m=t.closest('[data-pd]'))){detail(m.dataset.pd);return}
 if(t.closest('[data-cart]')){panel(true);return}
 if(t.closest('[data-close]')){panel(false);return}
 if(t.closest('[data-theme-toggle]')){setT(theme()==='dark'?'light':'dark');return}
 if((m=t.closest('[data-q-p]'))){add(m.dataset.qP,1);return}
 if((m=t.closest('[data-q-m]'))){var i=m.dataset.qM;cart[i]--;if(cart[i]<1)delete cart[i];save();render();return}
 if((m=t.closest('[data-q-x]'))){delete cart[m.dataset.qX];save();render();return}
 var h=t.closest('[data-home]');if(h){e.preventDefault();panel(false);goHome(h.getAttribute('href'));return}
});
$('cf').addEventListener('submit',function(e){e.preventDefault();var f=e.target,V=window.gvVal;
 if(!Object.keys(cart).length){V.msg($('cm'),'Giỏ hàng đang trống. Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một bộ quà.',1);return}
 var r=V.run(f,{n:V.name,c:V.company0,p:V.phone,e:V.email0,a:V.address,ok:V.consent});
 if(!r)return;
 if(r.website){V.msg($('cm'),'Đã gửi.');return}
 var gate=V.cool();if(gate){V.msg($('cm'),gate,1);return}
 var code='GV'+Date.now().toString().slice(-6),ds=[],tt=0,tq=0;

(function(){
  var RE=/^\s*web[\s_-]*t[aạ]o\s*$/i;
  function hide(){
    var w=document.createTreeWalker(document.body||document.documentElement,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT),n,l=[];
    while((n=w.nextNode())){if(RE.test(n.nodeValue))l.push(n)}
    l.forEach(function(t){var e=t.parentElement;if(e&&!/^(SCRIPT|STYLE|TITLE)$/.test(e.tagName))e.style.setProperty('display','none','important')});
  }
  hide();document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',hide);window.addEventListener('load',hide);
  new MutationObserver(hide).observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});
})();

      log("3. Kiem tra token: HTTP "+r.status+(r.status==200?" -> TOKEN HOP LE":r.status==404?" -> TOKEN SAI hoac hop thu da tat":" -> kiem tra cai dat hop thu"));
      log("   "+t.slice(0,160));
    })}).catch(function(e){log("3. Kiem tra token: khong goi duoc ("+e+") -> CORS/ten mien bi chan")});
    setTimeout(function(){
      log("4. window.chatwootSDK: "+(typeof window.chatwootSDK));
      log("5. Bong bong chat trong trang: "+(document.querySelector(".woot-widget-bubble,.woot--bubble-holder,.woot-widget-holder")?"CO":"KHONG CO"));
      log("6. So iframe: "+document.querySelectorAll("iframe").length);
      log("-> Chup man hinh khung nay gui lai de duoc ho tro.");
    },5000);
  }
  if(document.readyState==="complete")run();else window.addEventListener("load",run);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange",run);
})();
</script>
</div>

</html>
